content_head: Raymond III Count of Tripoli was a prominent Crusader leader who ruled the County of Tripoli during the twelfth century. He was the son of Raymond II and the brother of Raymond of Saint-Gilles. His reign was defined by significant military actions and political maneuvering within the Crusader States. He succeeded his father in 1145 and maintained control over the territory until his death in 1163.
